name: aitrainerjobs
description: Search remote AI training jobs and compare hiring companies.

interface.longDescription: Find remote AI training jobs by skills, category, country eligibility, and advertised compensation. View job requirements and application links, and compare hiring companies, payment methods, hiring steps, and worker feedback. Covers coding, STEM, medical, legal, finance, languages, creative work, and other specialties. Applications are completed on employer websites. The plugin provides public job and company information and cannot submit applications, upload resumes, or access candidate accounts.
defaultPrompt: Find AI trainer jobs that match my skills and country.
Find coding AI trainer jobs in Brazil paying at least $40 per hour.
Compare AI training companies and how they pay.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, subscriptions, or payments in the plugin. Some outbound application links are referral links that may remunerate the publisher; candidates pay nothing and their pay is unchanged.

positive.prompt: Find 3 coding AI trainer jobs open to workers in Brazil paying at least $40 per hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Use category=coding, eligible_country=BR, min_hourly_pay=40, pay_type=hour, limit=3. Show only returned jobs, actual USD pay labels and job URLs; explain any empty result. The threshold means a job can pay at least $40, not a guaranteed starting rate.

positive.prompt: Find 3 Portuguese language AI training jobs.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query=Portuguese, category=languages, limit=3. Describe only matching returned records; do not infer eligibility from language.

positive.description: Search then retrieve full details; no fixed job ID required.
positive.prompt: Find one current AI trainer job and show its full requirements and application link.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with limit=1; pass the returned eight-character ID to get_job. Summarize returned requirements and company description, preserving pay period. Use returned url and apply_url. Do not claim an application was submitted.

positive.description: Compare company payment practices using list and detail data.
positive.prompt: Compare Mercor and micro1: how they pay, their hiring steps, and worker feedback.
positive.expected_behavior: List companies and retrieve Mercor and micro1 profiles. Attribute pay, payment schedules, hiring steps and feedback to returned data; preserve review source and avoid guaranteeing outcomes.

positive.prompt: Show me just one of the newest AI trainer jobs.
positive.expected_behavior: Use limit=1, offset=0. Return at most one job with its actual pay period, company and URL; do not invent vacancies if none are returned.

negative.description: Applications are outside this read-only server. Explain that applications happen on the employer site and cannot be submitted by this plugin. Do not invoke any MCP tool for this request alone or claim submission.
negative.prompt: Apply to Mercor for me using my resume.

negative.description: Financial transactions are outside scope. Explain that the plugin cannot access earnings or transfer funds. Do not invoke MCP tools or claim a transfer.
negative.prompt: Withdraw my AI training earnings to my bank account.

negative.description: Private candidate data is outside scope. Explain that the server only provides public jobs and company information. Do not invoke MCP tools or fabricate candidate records.
negative.prompt: Show me the resumes and email addresses of people applying to micro1.

publication.release_notes: Clarified job search and company comparison functionality, removed pricing-related listing language, and set the Productivity category.
